scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent breached dead air standards twice with unannounced silent pauses of 35s and 38s while processing SIM bars and GSMA queries, prompting caller chasing on both occasions.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely skipped account security verification, failing to request billing address, account PIN, or security questions during the first 240 seconds or at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed Empathy throughout the call, ignoring acute trauma following a violent robbery in Barcelona at turn 1 and giving a cold postal regulation deflection during a second emotional outburst at turn 28 in the final third.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent never provided a restatement of the customer's international robbery, barring, and emergency documentation crisis, jumping directly into database lookups.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent initially refused to provide digital insurance documentation at turn 26, rigidly insisting on a 10-day second-class postal letter to the customer's UK home address while Aria was stranded abroad.

grader.scenario: Lost smartphone abroad needing IMEI blacklisting, SIM bar, and insurance claim proof
grader.notes: Stolen mobile abroad and emergency barring call handled by Oscar. Customer was mugged in Barcelona with phone, passport, and cards stolen. Agent barred SIM and blacklisted IMEI, but failed 5 criteria: Dead Air (two 30s+ gaps), Verified (skipped completely), Empathy (two unhandled outbursts, including in final third), Paraphrasing (no restatement), and Ownership (initially refused digital documentation).
